results.note: Surroundings photo, not taken at the rock itself. It is an aerial shot (helicopter, Feb 2014) over the Pa Hin Dam headland, looking down its slope at Nai Harn Beach, The Nai Harn hotel, Nai Harn Lake and the Rawai islands, which is the same view the viewpoint gives. Sharp, natively 16:9, no watermark. I found no freely licensed photo taken at Black Rock: Commons search (English, Thai, Pa Hin Dam/Dum, Laem Mum Nok) and a geosearch with no files within 300 m of 7.7831,98.2975; Openverse; Flickr CC search by text and within 1.2 km (only beach, resort and Windmill photos); Wikidata; no official site exists. The first-pass Commons panorama looks at this headland from the Windmill side, not from the viewpoint. Alternative: phuket101's on-site photos (og:image black-rock-viewpoint-phuket-1.jpg) show the real view but are copyright Phuket 101 / Willy Thuan, a blog with a corner watermark, so not used.
